# `implicit-net`: Undeclared identifier creates an implicit net / 未声明标识符创建了隐式网络

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A signal name is used in a net context without a declaration, so permissive Verilog rules silently create a one-bit wire.

### Risk

A typo or missing declaration can compile as the wrong one-bit connection, hiding width loss and disconnected logic.

### Fix

Declare every signal explicitly and enable default_nettype none around project RTL to turn accidental implicit nets into errors.

## 简体中文

### 原因

信号名在网络上下文中使用却没有声明，宽松的 Verilog 规则因此静默创建一位 wire。

### 风险

拼写错误或遗漏声明可能以错误的一位连接通过编译，从而掩盖位宽丢失和逻辑断连。

### 修复

显式声明所有信号，并在项目 RTL 中启用 default_nettype none，使意外隐式网络直接报错。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module implicit_net(input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  assign data_o = data_i & enable_typo;
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
`default_nettype none
module implicit_net(input logic data_i, input logic enable, output logic data_o);
  assign data_o = data_i & enable;
endmodule
`default_nettype wire
```
